title: MapleStory: Idle RPG Half Anniversary Special Mission Event
original_title: Half Anniversary Festival Special Mission Event & Festival Special Shop
author: Grendel
summary: The half-anniversary event offered daily and achievement missions, cumulative rewards, Festival Coins and Points, and a time-limited Festival Shop for players who had cleared Chapter 3-4.

sections.title: Mission structure
items: Daily missions reset at midnight server time and included connection, summoning, Arena, Flag Race, Quick Hunt, and Growth Dungeon goals.
Achievement missions covered Quick Hunt, Arena, Companion Summons, Festival Coins, Boss Raids, and Potential rerolls.
Cumulative milestones ended with a Half Anniversary Festival medal providing Main Stat +30.

sections.title: Festival Shop
items: Festival Coins could be exchanged for summoning tickets, enhancement materials, cubes, Hero Tokens, Spell Traces, and other rewards.
Several shop items used weekly, per-character, or date-specific purchase limits.

notes: Original MPStorys summary and structured facts verified against the official Nexon Forum event notice on 2026-07-25. The record is retained as ended event history.
event_name: Half Anniversary Festival Special Mission Event
requirements: Complete daily, achievement, or cumulative missions to earn event currency and rewards.
rewards: Half Anniversary Festival medal with Main Stat +30
participation_steps: Clear Chapter 3-4 to unlock the event.
Spend Festival Coins in the Festival Special Shop before it closes.
